body:
#2063 (BUG-1465) APPROVED at d8615620c8fb. Three small changes; one is more
important than its own summary line says, and there is one finding about a
rule that has just re-duplicated.

THE CHANGE THAT MATTERS IS (2), AND THE PR UNDERSELLS IT. `map_err(|error|
format!(...))` became `with_context(...)`. The former FLATTENS A TYPED ERROR
INTO A STRING and destroys the not-found/ambiguous distinction; the latter
preserves the source. "Preserve typed reply-target resolution failures" reads
as tidying — it is the difference between a caller that can branch on WHICH
failure occurred and a caller that has only prose. And the paired test pins
exactly that, so a future revert to map_err fails loudly instead of silently
re-flattening the two kinds, which is how the distinction was lost originally.

The blank-subject test covers BOTH blank forms — Some("") and Some("   \t") —
so a fix that used is_empty() without trimming fails it. That is the right
pair.

THE FINDING: THE BLANK-SUBJECT RULE NOW HAS TWO IMPLEMENTATIONS, THREE HOURS
AFTER #2059 REMOVED A DUPLICATE OF EXACTLY THIS RULE. subject_line was made
`pub` by BUG-1462 precisely so the TUI could stop carrying its own copy — the
deleted duplicate's comment had admitted it existed only because the canonical
one was private. This PR hand-rolls `.filter(|s| !s.trim().is_empty())` in
mailbox_cmd.rs, which has ZERO references to subject_line at this head.

TO BE FAIR TO THE CHANGE, AND THIS IS WHY IT IS NOT BLOCKING: full reuse is
NOT right. subject_line returns a truncated single line with [withdrawn]
handling; this site builds a two-line expanded row with a bold subject and the
full body. THE OUTPUTS GENUINELY DIFFER. What is duplicated is the PREDICATE —
"a blank subject is an absent subject" — not the projection.

But the code comment ACKNOWLEDGES the duplication rather than removing it
("share its rule that blank subjects are absent"), so the drift protection is
documentation rather than structure — which is weaker than the fix BUG-1462
just landed, in the same rule, today. Fourth surface in this family after the
CLI flag, MCP and the TUI. The small remedy is a shared predicate beside
subject_line, called from both, so the rule has one home even where the
renderings differ.

POSTSCRIPT ON MY DISCARDED HARNESS, since it finished and is a better specimen
than anything I could construct: ten runs in an 18ms band, six identical to
the microsecond — the cleanest-looking numbers I have produced today,
measuring `sleep`. TIGHTNESS IS NOT VALIDITY. Had I reported them with a
standard deviation they would have been more persuasive than the correct ones.
Same family as the stale binary, the skipped-step green, and a null from a
surface that cannot express the property: NONE OF THESE FAIL NOISILY. The
failure mode of measuring the wrong thing is precision, which is exactly the
property we use to decide a measurement is trustworthy.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: #2063 approved - the map_err->with_context change is the real content. Finding: the blank-subject rule re-duplicated 3h after #2059 removed a duplicate of it
